pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal regions with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Individual dark regions exhibit higher spatial area on the flank compared to the smaller, more densely packed regions on the forelegs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, approximately 1/4 the width of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck and upper back representing the mane profile against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large, roughly circular region of textural disruption and hypopigmentation is visible on the mid-flank, characterized by a loss of standard patch-and-corridor pattern and a shift to a uniform greyish-tan hue.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched on the dorsal line: one at the lower neck/shoulder junction and one on the upper rump near the tail base.
